title: NEAR protocol basics (public demo exam; real exams stay secret)

questions.prompt: On NEAR, storage staking costs 1 NEAR per how many bytes of contract storage? Give a single number.
A NEAR smart contract uses yield/resume to wait for an external response. How many blocks can it wait before the yielded promise times out? Give a single number.
NEAR gas keys (NEP-611) support up to how many independent nonce lanes per key? Give a single number.
The NEAR Intents protocol fee is how many pips per transaction? Give a single number.

When a user signs NEAR Intents with an ECDSA wallet such as MetaMask, which account format does the Verifier contract derive? A) 64-character hex implicit NEAR account B) Ethereum-style 0x address C) a named .near account. Answer with the letter.
